sentences.text: The appellant has been arrested on 19.11.2022 in connection with Crime No.807/2022 registered at Police Station- Kotwali, District- Guna (M.P.) in relation to the offence punishable under Section 376-D of IPC and Sections 3(1)(w-i) and 3(2)(v,a), 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act.

P ro s ec utio n story, in short, is that on 17/11/2022 the complainant/prosecutrix alongwith her father and sister lodged a computerized complaint stating therein that she lives in Talaiya Mohalla and is doing B.A. from Kasturba Collage.
Co-accused- R amu Meena who is the resident of Ghatkhedi Kumbhraj, is her friend.
Today, on 17/11/2022, at around 6:00 PM, she had gone to Meena Bazar fair with her friend - Deeksha Ahirwar where present appellant accused- Ranu Meena came with her friend- Shivam Meena.
After visiting the fair, accused- Ranu said that it is night, let me drop you both home in my car.
Ranu's friend- Shivam had come with a black colour car and thereafter, complainant and her friend sat in his car.
Appellant was sitting in that car.

From the car,
both of them first dropped Diksha outside her house at Budhe Balaji and after that she asked both of them to leave at her house too, then accused Ranu asked the co-accused Shivam to stop the car right here on the side, then the co-accused stopped the car on the side.
Thereafter, appellant/accused- Ranu came to the back seat of the car where she was sitting and committed sexual intercourse with her forcefully in the car.
She shouted to Shivam that brother help me but Shivam did not say anything and kept sitting silently on the driver's seat of the car.
Thereafter, both of them left her there.
On the basis of aforesaid, crime has been registered against the appellant and co- accused.
Thereafter, applicant was arrested and car used in the incident bearing registration No.MP08-A-7717 was also seized.
Prosecutrix was sent for medical examination.
No external and internal injury was found on the body of the prosecutrix and no definite opinion was given by the doctor regarding sexual intercourse.

Appellant was arrested on 19.11.2022 and after investigation,
charge sheet has been submitted.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is aged 22 years and he has been falsely implicated in the case.
Appellant is in custody since 19.11.2022 and he is the permanent resident of District- Guna (M.P.).
There is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the evidence.
The appellant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made.

Learned counsel for the State opposed the appeal and prayed for its rejection by contending that on the basis of the allegations and the material available on record, no case for grant of bail is made out.
Heard the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on the merits of the case, the present appeal is allowed and order dated 06.02.2023 is set-aside and it is directed that if appellant furnishes a cash surety of Rs.25,000/- alongwith a personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
